_COMMENT_FILE_PATH: SAVE THIS FILE AS: config_dryrun_telegram.json — in the ROOT of your NostalgiaForInfinity repo (same folder as NostalgiaForInfinityX7.py, README.md, docker-compose.yml). NOT inside user_data/, NOT inside configs/.
_COMMENT_purpose: Dry-run only — no real orders are ever placed (dry_run: true). This simulates trades using live market data and sends Telegram notifications on every simulated entry/exit, exactly like real trading, but with zero capital at risk. Do not flip dry_run to false without a separate, deliberate review.
_COMMENT_restart_architecture: This runs under a GitHub Actions cron job that restarts every ~5 hours (job time limit + schedule reliability — see backtest.yml comments). db_url points to Supabase Postgres (not local SQLite) specifically so open simulated trades survive that restart gap instead of being lost.
_COMMENT_position_adjustment: NostalgiaForInfinityX7 requires position_adjustment_enable=true for its Grinding V2 and Buyback systems to function (per the strategy's own documentation) — without this, the strategy behaves in ways its author never intended/tested.
_COMMENT_pairlist: Switched from a static 4-pair list to a dynamic VolumePairList (~100 pairs by trading volume), matching NostalgiaForInfinity's own documented recommendation of 40-80 pairs — a handful of pairs was too narrow to expect meaningful signal frequency. exchange.pair_whitelist is now empty on purpose: VolumePairList generates the whitelist itself at runtime. The blacklist regex still excludes leveraged tokens, which NFI's docs strongly recommend blacklisting.
_COMMENT_filters: AgeFilter avoids brand-new/thin-history listings; PriceFilter avoids extremely low-priced coins prone to precision issues; SpreadFilter avoids illiquid pairs with wide bid/ask spreads. These are standard, non-strategy-specific hygiene filters — they don't touch NostalgiaForInfinityX7's own entry/exit logic.
_COMMENT_telegram: token/chat_id below are dummy placeholders satisfying the config schema's required fields. The REAL values are injected at runtime via FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__TOKEN / FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__CHAT_ID environment variables (sourced from GitHub Secrets in the workflow) — never commit real credentials into this file. Freqtrade listens for incoming Telegram commands (/status, /balance, /profit, etc) automatically whenever the bot process is running — no extra setup needed beyond enabled: true. The 'keyboard' below just adds quick-tap buttons in the Telegram app.
_COMMENT_db_url: Real value injected via FREQTRADE__DB_URL env var (GitHub Secret), pointing at Supabase Postgres — e.g. postgresql://postgres:<password>@<project>.supabase.co:5432/postgres. This placeholder (SQLite) is never actually used at runtime.
